name: openinframap
description: Open Infrastructure Map, a view of infrastructure data in OpenStreetMap
readme_summary: Open Infrastructure Map visualizes global infrastructure data sourced from OpenStreetMap. It provides a dedicated map interface to explore and understand various types of infrastructure, making complex network data accessible.
key_features: Visualizes global infrastructure data
Uses OpenStreetMap as a data source
Provides a dedicated map interface
Supports multilingual translations
primary_use_case: To provide a clear and accessible map visualization of global infrastructure data derived from OpenStreetMap.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized, glowing world map made of interconnected lines and nodes representing various infrastructure networks like power lines, pipelines, and roads. Tiny, diverse figures are seen interacting with the map, pointing to specific connections or data points. Subtle UI elements resembling a map interface with data overlays are integrated into the scene. The overall mood is one of discovery and understanding of complex global systems. The style should be a vibrant, 3D isometric illustration with a clean, modern aesthetic, emphasizing clarity and interconnectedness. The repository name 'OpenInfraMap' is subtly etched on a digital tablet within the scene.

name: kimi-k3-in-c
description: A 2.78-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 running inference on a single CPU in 8.24 GB of RAM. Portable C99: no BLAS, no framework, no GPU.
readme_summary: This repository enables running a massive 2.78 trillion parameter Kimi K3 language model on a single CPU with as little as 8.24 GB of RAM. It achieves this through a portable C99 implementation with zero external dependencies, allowing for efficient inference even on resource-constrained hardware.
key_features: 2.78 trillion parameter model inference
Runs on a single CPU
Requires only 8.24 GB of RAM (peak RSS)
Portable C99 implementation
Zero external dependencies (no BLAS, no framework, no GPU)
Memory-efficient operation
Checkpoint size: 1.56 TB
Engine size: 176 KB
primary_use_case: To run a very large language model (Kimi K3) for inference on standard consumer hardware (single CPU, limited RAM) without requiring specialized hardware like GPUs or complex software frameworks.
cover_image_prompt: A lone, weathered traveler with a backpack containing a single, small, glowing C99 compiler icon, standing at the foot of a colossal, ancient mountain range representing the 2.78 trillion parameter Kimi K3 model. The traveler is using a simple, handheld magnifying glass (representing the C99 engine) to examine a tiny, intricate map (representing the model's output). The map, when viewed through the magnifying glass, reveals complex, beautiful patterns and text, demonstrating the power contained within the small tool. The scene is set in a vast, open landscape under a clear sky, emphasizing the accessibility and portability of the technology. The overall mood is one of quiet determination and the triumph of ingenuity over scale. Style: Digital painting with a focus on atmospheric lighting and clear visual storytelling.

name: ai-copywriter
description: An AI copywriter that uses real copywriting skills + real marketing knowledge with human tone.
readme_summary: This AI copywriter is a portable agent skill that writes compelling marketing copy, such as headlines and product descriptions, while ensuring the output reads like human-written text. It achieves this by integrating real copywriting skills and marketing knowledge with a humanizer component that removes AI-generated writing patterns.
key_features: Writes attention-grabbing copy (clickbait titles, short descriptions, microcopy, subject lines)
Removes AI-generated writing patterns for a human tone
Built on blader's Humanizer (33 detectable, fixable patterns)
Incorporates marketing research from enso.bot/research
Focuses on understanding the reader's feelings and explaining concepts simply
Interviews for ICP, category, and story before writing
Pressure-tests the story for compelling elements
Outputs plain Markdown for broad compatibility
primary_use_case: To generate marketing copy that is both effective in capturing attention and indistinguishable from human writing, by deeply understanding the target audience and simplifying complex concepts.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan, reminiscent of a master calligrapher, meticulously crafting a beautiful, glowing scroll of text. The artisan is surrounded by faint, ethereal whispers representing 'AI patterns' that are being actively smoothed out and integrated into the human-like script. In the background, a diverse crowd of people are reacting positively to the text, their faces illuminated with understanding and engagement. Subtle digital particles and a faint UI overlay with the repository name 'AI Copywriter' are visible. The scene is set in a warm, inviting studio with soft, focused lighting, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with rich details and a harmonious color palette.

name: twig
description: 🌱 Twig — Git-клиент с автоматизациями и журналом команд
readme_summary: Twig is a standalone desktop Git client for macOS, Windows, and Linux, built with Electron, React, and Vite. It offers a comprehensive interface for managing Git repositories, focusing on visualizing commit history, staging changes, and executing various Git operations through an intuitive user experience.
key_features: Real commit graph with virtualized, paginated view
Uncommitted work at a glance with staging and diff views
Sidebar for repository navigation (LOCAL/REMOTE/TAGS)
Commit panel with full message, author card, parents, and changed files
Working tree with staged/unstaged/untracked lists and line-level staging
Extensive history operations via context menu
Interactive rebase editor
Three-way conflict editor
Drag and drop functionality
primary_use_case: A user-friendly desktop application for managing Git repositories with advanced visualization and operational features.
cover_image_prompt: A master cartographer meticulously drawing a complex, interconnected map of historical events. The cartographer uses a quill that glows with digital energy, etching lines representing Git commits onto parchment that displays code snippets. Branch names appear as labels on different paths of the map, and small icons indicate staged or unstaged changes. In the background, a digital workbench shows a console with Git commands being executed. The overall mood is one of focused creation and clarity, with a clean, modern aesthetic. The image should be in a 3D isometric illustration style, emphasizing the detailed map and the blend of traditional cartography with digital elements, with the name 'Twig' subtly integrated into the cartographer's tools.

name: 0-CODE
description: An autonomous development loop for Claude Code and OpenCode. The agent plans, writes, tests and commits on its own; the loop keeps going after the session ends. Zero runtime dependencies. Proven by running it: 2.5 hours unattended, 6 real commits, $10.25 — and every release since v1.0.0 spent finding its own claims to be false.
readme_summary: 0-CODE is an autonomous development loop for AI agents like Claude Code and OpenCode. It enables agents to independently plan, write, test, and commit code, maintaining state and continuing work across sessions without runtime dependencies.
key_features: Autonomous development loop for AI agents
Plans, writes, tests, and commits code independently
State survives restarts and continues across sessions
Zero runtime dependencies
External supervisor for OpenCode and internal stop hook for Claude Code
Shared decision logic for consistent behavior
Cost accumulation tracking and per-turn budget caps
File locking to prevent concurrent runs
Guardrails that survive agent attempts to remove them
Tracking of long-running jobs and their status
Ownership proof for concurrent sessions
Review of remaining plan against work shown
Production audit loop for release verification
primary_use_case: To automate the entire software development lifecycle for AI agents, allowing them to work on tasks autonomously and continuously.
cover_image_prompt: A diligent robotic gardener tending to a sprawling digital garden. The gardener, named '0-CODE', meticulously plants seeds (code snippets) into fertile soil (project files), waters them with data streams, and prunes overgrown branches (bug fixes). Small, glowing orbs representing tests float around, and completed flowers (features) bloom vibrantly. The garden's roadmap is displayed on a holographic scroll in the background. Subtle UI elements showing progress and commit logs are integrated into the garden's pathways. The scene is set in a bright, futuristic greenhouse with a clean, isometric 3D illustration style, emphasizing growth and continuous development.
